about.title: About
about.p1: Many enter the world of cynology unprepared, curious and sincere — yet, as in so much else, problems sometimes catch them on the first steps, and with time some become too large. A tradition of some twenty years gives us the freedom to offer you, as a company, help so that everything becomes easier, faster and better.
about.p2: Through these pages you can get to know us and our partners, get answers to some of your questions, resolve basic problems with your own dog, and even enjoy cynology if it becomes more than a pastime.
about.p3: Carolo Canis Ltd. is a small, tightly focused company working in cynology in the areas of dog training, trade in dog equipment and food, and cynology advice arising from the owner’s authority as a court expert in cynology and a working-dog judge.

method.title: How we work
method.p1: The work is based on courses with dog owners. Everyone is trained individually, as we long ago dropped group classes (because no two dogs are the same, and neither are their owners’ demands).
method.p2: Courses take place once a week in an agreed slot, on an “open” time principle: you are not bound to a precise minute, but may arrive when it suits you within the agreed window, observing only the order of who came first — or a previously booked obligation. After the courses we recommend taking a training exam, as a measure of success in training your dog (and we are ready to help at many levels). Exams are also a sign to those around you that you have a trained, well-mannered dog, and confirmation of what you have invested in your companion.
method.p3: Course payment is in instalments, following the level reached in a given phase of training. You are not obliged to pay anything in advance, and you are not charged for missed sessions due to “higher” reasons (the dog’s illness, your inability to attend, and the like). Course prices are a matter of agreement based on the owner’s aims and needs, and you will be informed about them in direct contact.
